_why: Which provider build produced each captured stream. `providers verify` checks that a new build still offers the CLI FLAGS an adapter's argv needs, and explicitly does not check the event VOCABULARY -- that needs a captured stream. These CLIs update weekly, so a vocabulary regression would present as 'jobs stopped failing to parse' with no obvious cause. This file is the baseline that makes drift visible.
_captured_version: null means the exact build was not recorded at capture time. That is honest rather than guessed: a wrong baseline is worse than an absent one, because it reads as a check that passed. Re-capture to establish it.
